PARTYWALL DECLARATION OF RESTRICTIONS, made as of this 15th day of July, 2002, by Landmark Projects IV, Inc., having offices at 250 Park Avenue South, New York, NY 10003 (hereinafter referred to as the “Developer") and NYC Partnership Housing Development Fund Company, Inc., having offices at One Battery Park Plaza, New York, New York 10004, (hereinafter referred to as the “NYCP") (Developer and NYCP are hereinafter collectively referred to as the"Declarants"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, NYCP is the owner of the real property located in the Borough of Manhattan as described on Schedule “A””(Block 1913, Lot 6 and part of Lot 106 and Block 1913, Lot 7 and part of Lot 106), annexed hereto and made a part hereof, upon WHEREAS, the Developer has built two residential buildings in such a manner that each of the buildings shall adjoin the other and shall be connected to each other by a common Party Wall ("Party Wall"); WHEREAS theDeclarants desire to declare thefollowingrestrictions,covenants and agreements governing said Party Wall; and WHEREAS,the home designated as Block 1913,Lot 7 and part of Lot 106 is located at street address 145 West 128th Street, New York, N.Y. and the home on the other side of the Party Wall is designated as Block 1913, Lot 6 and part of Lot 106 is located at street address149West128thStreet,NewYork,NY; NOW THEREFORE, the following declaration of restrictions, covenants and agreements shall run with the land and be binding upon the Declarants herein, their heirs, successors and assigns and shall run with the land and be binding upon each successive owner ofBlock1913Lot 7and part of Lot106andofBlock1913Lot-6andpartof Lot 106, New York, N.Y. and the heirs, successors and assigns of each such subsequent owner. 1.The Party Wall was constructed in such a fashion as to be located an equal distance on or over the respective adjoining lots with the midline of the Party Wall being located as nearly as possible on the common boundary line and it is understood that minor variations may be present due to topographical problems or construction requirements. 2. ThePartyWallshall beused andmaintained as aPartyWallforever and theowner of the lot on each side of thePartyWall, shall be licensed and permitted to enter upon the premises of the owner on the other side of the Party Wall to make intentions to do so.
